# Agentic Builders

> Agentic Builders is an early-stage venture fund (idea to pre-seed) for agent-native products: products AI agents use and tools for building agent products. Investments of $30–100k on a standard post-money SAFE. One form; for teams that fit, a four-week investment track and a decision on an investment at its end. Apply: https://accidental-podium-c67.notion.site/a5032a0b4b1982f89291014f2df73ba9 · Contact: hey@agenticbuilders.ai · Updated 2026-10-20.

## Pages

- [For founders](https://agenticbuilders.ai/): investment track, thesis, selection, team introduction and FAQ
- [Full reference for AI agents](https://agenticbuilders.ai/llms-full.txt): fund details, investment track terms, application instructions and field schema
- [Portfolio](https://agenticbuilders.ai/portfolio/): companies, introductions for angels and VCs, monthly newsletter
- [Team](https://agenticbuilders.ai/team/): people, responsibilities and Abi, the fund’s AI agent
- [Privacy policy](https://agenticbuilders.ai/privacy/): how application and contact data are handled
- [Legal notice](https://agenticbuilders.ai/legal/): operator, investment track terms and disclaimers

## Application

- Eligibility: Founders can apply from anywhere in the world, including before incorporating. We invest only in US-incorporated companies, so a US company must be in place before an investment is completed. We back teams building products AI agents use or tools for building agent products, from idea to pre-seed. We consider experience, founder-led sales and speed of execution.

- [Live application form](https://accidental-podium-c67.notion.site/a5032a0b4b1982f89291014f2df73ba9): 16 questions, 7 required. Labels, helper text, required fields and choices verified 2026-10-20.
- [Exact field schema and submission instructions](https://agenticbuilders.ai/llms-full.txt): match the live form's question labels, keep helper text separate, and ask the applicant for missing required answers. The pitch deck or website question is optional.

- [Fina](https://fina.team/): Automation for finance teams.
